title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the penalty on large coefficients increases, which can reduce the variance of the model.

title: Lambda Approaching Zero
text: When lambda (λ) approaches zero, the regularization term becomes negligible, and ridge regression behaves more like ordinary least squares regression.

title: Observational Variance
text: Observational variance refers to the variability in the data that the model tries to capture. Consider how lambda affects this variance.

title: Conclusion on Variance
text: Does decreasing lambda to zero reduce the observational variance to zero?
